name: StellarDrive Demo TF Advanced
author: Romalaure
description: TF group advanced mods, in English and French (setting Language). 7 new planets around Otrera and a second galaxy, Erebus, reached through a portal: deserts, mountains, glaciers, a futuristic abandoned city, jungle, volcanic, ocean, fungal and crystal worlds, a pirate fortress planet. Ruins, villages, wrecks and buildings with chests, new ores (titanium, quartz, cryonite, meteorite, uranium), nuclear power and dark matter. Space stations to build (habitation, corridors, airlock, docking, laboratory, infirmary, life support, observatory), wood, glass and iron building parts. Ship computer screens, advanced engines, battery and breaker, force fields, portal generator, cartography table, research tree branch. 3 black holes, abandoned stations, asteroid fields, pirates (with Arsenal) with incoming raids, pirate radars (1,000 / 5,000 / 20,000 km) and a stealth generator. In-game wiki in the Guide (G). Needs SDModKit. Every player needs the mod.
